result.summary: Found 1 visually broken area: the bottom navigation is partially obscured by an overlapping gray bar/gesture handle, which makes the controls look clipped and harder to use.

issues.description: A thick gray horizontal bar overlaps the bottom navigation area, partially covering the search and middle icons.
issues.suggestion: Add proper safe-area/bottom padding so the app’s navigation sits above the system gesture bar and remains fully visible and tappable.
